description: Progressively hides trailing flex children when the container is too narrow (row) or too short (column) to show them at their minimum size. Apply to the container — all direct children are managed automatically.
browserSupport: Chrome 137+ — requires sibling-index(), CSS if(style()) with registered @property range queries

attributes.name: data-direction
attributes.description: Omit for row (default). Set to 'column' for vertical truncation along the block axis. Requires an explicit height on the container — without one, cqb resolves to 0 and no children are hidden.

attributes.name: data-min-child-width
attributes.description: Minimum inline size each child must occupy (row direction). Children that would overflow at this size are hidden. Also sets the container's own min-width so the last child is never hidden.

attributes.name: data-min-child-height
attributes.description: Minimum block size each child must occupy (column direction). Also sets the container's own min-height so the last child is never hidden.

cssProperties.name: --flex-truncate-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap between children. Must match the visual gap between items — used in the threshold formula.

cssProperties.name: --flex-truncate-min-width
cssProperties.description: CSS override for min child width — takes precedence over data-min-child-width. Set via inline style or a class rule.

cssProperties.name: --flex-truncate-min-height
cssProperties.description: CSS override for min child height — takes precedence over data-min-child-height. Tip: set this on a parent ancestor so the ancestor's min-height and the child threshold formula share the same value.

notes: All direct children receive order: sibling-index() automatically — do not set order on direct children.
The container enforces its own min-width (row) / min-height (column) equal to one child minimum — the last child is never hidden.
Column mode: the container needs an explicit height. Without one, cqb = 0 and nothing is hidden.
Children's display property is owned by the class — do not set display on direct children.
To share the min-height value between a resizable parent and the flex-truncate threshold, set --flex-truncate-min-height on the parent; it inherits to the child.

examples.label: Row (default)
examples.description: 5 metric cards that progressively hide as the container narrows.

examples.label: Row — custom min-width
examples.description: Wider children (220px) with a larger gap (12px).

examples.label: Column
examples.description: Children stack vertically and hide from the bottom as the container shortens.
